description: Add advanced agent skills, game gallery, share functionality, and polish. Implement additional agent capabilities: game difficulty adjustment, theme customization, sound toggle instructions, game export (download HTML), game gallery page showing previously created games, and template suggestions. Polish the UI with loading states and animations.
steps: Create src/pages/GameGallery.tsx - A gallery page showing game templates/presets that users can browse and launch directly. Show 8+ game cards with preview thumbnails (simple canvas-rendered previews or emoji/icon representations), title, description. Clicking a card generates that game and navigates to workspace.
Add route '/gallery' in src/App.tsx for the GameGallery page.
Update src/components/Header.tsx - Add navigation links: Home, Create, Gallery. Make the header a proper nav bar visible on all pages.

Implement game export/download in GameWorkspace - The 'Share Game' button should trigger downloading the current game as a standalone HTML file. Create a utility function in src/engine/exportGame.ts that creates a Blob from the game code and triggers a download.

Add a 'Template & Assets' panel in GameWorkspace - When clicked, show a slide-out panel (or modal) listing available game templates that the user can switch to. Selecting a template regenerates the game with that template.

Enhance the chat AI responses in the workspace - Create src/engine/chatResponses.ts that generates contextual, helpful responses based on what modification was made. Include suggestions for what the user can try next (e.g., 'Try asking me to add power-ups!' or 'You can change the background color').

Add loading/generating animations - When a game is being generated, show a proper loading state with progress-like animation (similar to the terminal typing effect) in both CreateGame and GameWorkspace.
Ensure all navigation flows work properly: Landing -> Create -> Workspace -> (can go back), Gallery -> Workspace, Header nav works from any page.
acceptance_criteria: Game Gallery page at /gallery shows 8+ game presets that launch directly
Header navigation works across all pages (Home, Create, Gallery)
Share/Download button produces a downloadable .html file containing the game
Template & Assets panel shows available templates and allows switching
Chat responses are contextual and include suggestions for next actions
Loading states are shown during game generation
All navigation flows work without errors
npm run build succeeds with no TypeScript errors
findings: All features implemented successfully. Build passes with no new lint errors. Header uses react-router-dom Link which requires it to be rendered inside BrowserRouter - works fine since it is imported by pages that are already inside the router. The updateLastAssistantMessage function was added to gameStore to allow contextual chat responses to replace generic ones. Template panel uses animate-slide-in-right custom animation added to tailwind config.
